entity_geography.text: ly responsible for the results and quality of implemented activities. All contributions of hosting organisations must comply with the Erasmus quality standards. (Erasmus+ Programme Guide 2023 (Version 2, 21.12.22) The Erasmus+ Programme Guide | Erasmus+ (europa.eu) Currently Donegal ETB have a requirement for service providers (hosting organisations) for Malaga, Spain, but welcome responses from providers from any receiving country in Europe.
